_about: Confirmed decisions governing the Findigs GTM executive dashboard. Notion 'Data Definitions' is the system of record; this file is the bundled fallback and must match it. The refresh skill stops on any mismatch.

fiscal_year.note: Q1 Jan-Mar, Q2 Apr-Jun, Q3 Jul-Sep, Q4 Oct-Dec

terminal_stages.rule: Win/loss is derived from dealstage membership only. hs_is_closed_won / hs_is_closed_lost are unreliable on migrated records and are never used.

not_used.hs_projected_amount: reference only; equals amount x hs_deal_stage_probability
not_used.sdr_owner_new: confirmed 2026-09-23: diverges heavily from sdr_owner on the same deals (a team-reassignment pattern, not a completeness difference). sdr_owner is authoritative for the SDR section. Caveat added 2026-09-28: every live currently-configured HubSpot saved report for SDR reporting (Demos Booked by SDR, Opps Generated by SDR, SDR Outbound By Stage, 8 per-rep Quota Q3 reports) groups by sdr_owner_new instead, and one of those tiles (SDR Outbound By Stage) inconsistently filters on sdr_owner but charts by sdr_owner_new. Recent-deal (last 30 days) real-assignment rate favors sdr_owner (100% vs 88.7%). This dashboard follows the Notion-confirmed decision; flagged as SDR-1 in this section's data quality flags, not silently resolved.
not_used.demo_completed_date__c: confirmed 2026-09-23, re-verified 2026-09-28: 0 population on any deal created since 2026-08-01 — dead field since the Salesforce migration cutover. 'Meeting held' timing is a status flag (demo_completed__c) with no reliable date of its own.
not_used.attribution_source_drill_down: a distinct field from deal_source_drill_down (100% disagreement rate on the 759 deals where both happen to be populated, verified 2026-09-28) and from deal_source_group. Not used anywhere in this dashboard; deal_source_group is the confirmed field for the SDR channel-mix bucketing.

segment_rule.note: Raw deal 'segment' free text is displayed alongside but never used for grouping or filtering.

migration.rule: createdate on SALESFORCE-sourced records is the original Salesforce created date. Included everywhere with a footnote; native-only toggle available in Pipeline Generation. Sales-cycle tile shows all-deal mean with the post-cutoff mean alongside.

pipeline_generation.population: createdate >= fiscal year start, any dealstage
pipeline_generation.prior_period_comparison: prior quarter at the same elapsed-day count

populations.open: pipeline in scope AND dealstage not in terminal_stages
populations.won_fy: dealstage in terminal_stages.won AND closedate >= FY start
populations.created_fy: pipeline = new_logo AND createdate >= FY start
populations.sdr_opportunity: pipeline = new_logo AND createdate >= FY start AND sdr_owner IS NOT NULL (subset of created_fy; no separate pull)

sdr_section.opportunity_rule: sdr_owner IS NOT NULL, timestamped by createdate. Findigs-specific and deliberately broader than 'reached a later pipeline stage' — every SDR-owned New Logo deal counts as an opportunity from its create date. HubSpot's 'Unassigned' placeholder owner (id 8309346) counts as populated and is included in opportunity count/amount; excluded only from the per-SDR breakdown chart's real-person rows.
sdr_section.meeting_held_rule: demo_completed__c = 'Yes'. demo_completed_date__c is never used (see fields.not_used).
sdr_section.rolling_window: trailing 30 days = [as_of date - 29 days, as_of date], inclusive, ET. Cohort is by the triggering event's own date (demo_booked__c for booked/held metrics, createdate for opportunities-per-SDR), tracked to whatever eventual outcome — not a point-in-time snapshot.

channel_buckets.note: Raw deal_source_group values are capitalized (Outbound/Inbound/Referral/Event), verified 2026-09-28 against live search_crm_objects records — a query_crm_data aggregate GROUP BY had displayed them lowercased, which is a display normalization in that tool's TSV output, not the true stored value. referral is folded into Inbound by confirmed decision; that bucket is mostly Zoominfo / SalesIntel list-provider deals, not literal customer referrals. deal_source_group is independently set from deal_source_drill_down and attribution_source_drill_down, not a lookup of either.

goal_by_segment.note: Confirmed placeholder 2026-09-23: no quota file existed. Re-checked 2026-09-28 against Findigs_FY2027_Capacity_Quota_Model (Drive, modified 2026-09-24) — does not supersede the placeholder: that workbook is FY2027 (this dashboard's fiscal year is calendar 2026), scenario-based (Base/Conservative/Moderate/Aggressive — four different targets, no single confirmed number), and uses a different segment taxonomy (SMB floor-excluded below 500 units, plus a separate Strategic tier) than this dashboard's governed 3-band segment_rule. Goal = 0 means 'not configured'; the build suppresses percent-to-goal rather than estimating a target, and never treats a missing goal as $0 achievement. Replace this block wholesale once a quota workbook confirmed for calendar FY2026 and this dashboard's segment bands is supplied.

sdr_section.known_field_conflicts: See fields.not_used.sdr_owner_new and fields.not_used.attribution_source_drill_down. Surfaced as DQ flags SDR-1 and SDR-2 in the dashboard itself, not resolved here.

distribution.slack_dm_note: All errors/stops go here as a DM, never to slack_channel_id. slack_channel_id only receives successful-refresh posts.

notion.preflight_query: SELECT "Metric", "Formula", "Object & fields", "Scope / filters", "Exclusions", "Null handling", "Status" FROM "collection://75eddbb8-a6d4-41ff-b324-de338360c756" WHERE "Used by" LIKE '%GTM executive dashboard%' OR "Used by" LIKE '%Pipeline Generation section%' OR "Used by" LIKE '%SDR section%'
notion.note: Preflight compares each row's Formula / fields / scope / exclusions / null handling against the mapped config keys. Any row with Status other than Confirmed, or any semantic mismatch, stops the run.
